assessment.summary: IL6R (P08887) is a well-validated, clinically proven drug target with two approved biologic antagonists (tocilizumab and sarilumab). Structural coverage is solid with 10 PDB entries including 8 ligand-bound structures at near-high resolution (best 2.4Å), and the literature base is substantial and actively growing. The primary evidence gap is the complete absence of small-molecule IC50 data in ChEMBL, reflecting that current approved therapies are monoclonal antibodies targeting the extracellular domain rather than small molecules.
evidence_gaps: No small-molecule IC50 data in ChEMBL (0 entries) — all approved drugs are biologics (mAbs), indicating the small-molecule druggability of IL6R remains largely unexplored
Best PDB resolution is 2.4Å, just at the threshold for high confidence; no sub-2Å structures available

AlphaFold mean pLDDT of 77.9 with only 67.5% high-confidence fraction suggests some disordered regions, likely in intracellular or linker domains, which may limit structure-based small-molecule design
No information on allosteric binding sites or cryptic pockets that could enable small-molecule intervention beyond the cytokine-binding interface
Oral bioavailability and small-molecule tractability of the IL-6/IL-6R protein-protein interaction interface has not been demonstrated
